info.description: Checks PostgreSQL schema changes before they reach production: what changed, what each change locks or breaks, and how to apply it safely. All inputs are PostgreSQL DDL, such as the output of pg_dump --schema-only. The analysis endpoints store nothing; the /api/v1/analyses endpoints save the request and its result until they expire, so they can be shared by link. Accounts (/api/v1/auth, /api/v1/account) need the server's database.
info.title: SchemaGuard API

tags.description: Permalinks. Saving stores the SQL you send for 30 days, so do not save schemas that must stay private. Anyone with the id can open the analysis; only the holder of the delete token can delete it.
tags.name: Saved analyses

tags.description: Sign up, log in, keep a session going and end it. A session answer holds a short-lived access token for Authorization: Bearer; the refresh token is set as the httpOnly cookie __Secure-sg-refresh, which a browser sends to /api/v1/auth only. Accounts need the server's database (503 without it).

Change.description: One difference between the two schemas

confidence.description: For a rename candidate: how likely the rename is, from 0 to 1

cosmetic.description: True if the change is only a different way of writing the same thing

rename.description: For a rename candidate: the rename to send back to /plan once confirmed

table.description: The table the change belongs to, if any

after.description: The schema as it should become
after.example: CREATE TABLE users (id int PRIMARY KEY, email text NOT NULL);

before.description: The schema as it is now
before.example: CREATE TABLE users (id int PRIMARY KEY);

Credentials.description: An email and a password, to sign up or log in

password.description: At sign-up: 8 to 256 characters, not one of the 10,000 most common passwords, not the email

Diagnostic.description: A problem found in one of the SQL inputs

input.description: Which input: before, after, schema or migration

significant.description: Number of changes that are not cosmetic

change.description: The change the finding is about (risk reports only)

effect.description: What the statement locks and for how long, in one line

LintRequest.description: A migration script and the schema it will run on

migration.description: The migration script, as it will be run

schema.description: The schema the migration runs on

LintedStatement.description: One statement of the script and what was found in it

ModelColumn.description: A column of the merged model

previousType.description: The old type, when the type changed

type.description: Type as SQL, from the new schema unless the column was removed

ModelReference.description: A foreign key of either schema

from.description: The table that holds the key

tables.description: Every table of either schema, sorted by name

columns.description: The new schema's columns in their order, then the removed ones

NameDto.description: A schema-qualified name of a table or type

Operation.description: A kind of statement and what it does to a table, as measured on PostgreSQL 16

lock.description: Lock on the table, or null

lockEffect.description: What the lock blocks, or null

referencedLock.description: Lock on tables it references through a foreign key, or null

PasswordCheck.description: The account's password, typed again to confirm an action

PlanRequest.description: Two versions of a schema and how to plan the way between them

after.description: The schema as it should become

before.description: The schema as it is now

lockTimeout.description: Value for SET lock_timeout at the top of a safe plan. Default 5s

renames.description: Renames a person has confirmed, from the rename candidates of the diff

route.description: SAFE avoids long locks; DIRECT is one plain statement per change. Default SAFE

complete.description: True if running the steps reaches the new schema

needsDecisions.description: True if some step carries a caution

sql.description: The plan as a script for psql

scope.description: schema: judged from two schemas; script: only when a script is linted

SavedAnalysis.description: An analysis that was just saved

deleteToken.description: Needed to delete the analysis before it expires. Shown only now; it cannot be recovered

expiresAt.description: After this moment the analysis is deleted

result.description: The result, as the matching analysis endpoint returns it

level.description: NONE, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH or CRITICAL

Session.description: A logged-in session. The refresh token travels separately, in an httpOnly cookie the browser keeps and sends to /api/v1/auth only

accessToken.description: Send as Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>. A JWT (RFC 9068); keep it in memory only

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires; then call /api/v1/auth/refresh

Step.description: One statement of a migration plan

cautions.description: Risks the plan could not remove; each needs a decision

transactional.description: False if the statement must run outside a transaction block

StoredAnalysis.description: A saved analysis, as it was computed

engineVersion.description: The SchemaGuard version that computed the result

request.description: The request, as it was sent

result.description: The result, as it was returned

Unplanned.description: A change PostgreSQL has no statement for

accessToken.description: The accessToken of a session (sign-up, login or refresh)

refreshCookie.description: The httpOnly refresh cookie set by sign-up, login and refresh
